Party finds Mizora in her pod in Moonrise Towers and chooses whether to release her or flush her down the tube. If alive, she flies off to wait for Wyll.

Occurs if the player clicks on the first mind flayer pod with someone inside. They can attempt to free the captive - Shadowheart - but the magical runes guarding the pod prevent this.The player can leave her stuck, or try to find another way to free her. Via a skillcheck or via Shadowheart herself, they may receive a clue to examine the console next to the pod.
After meeting Karlach and choosing whether to keep her alive or kill her, Mizora appears in camp to turn Wyll into a devil or reward him with a new power.

Mizora contacts party after she's been captured by the cultists. Not a lot of choices here, but you can try and find out how she got caught and express opinion on getting her out. This version if Wyll is not with you.
context: The party finds Mizora — a half‑devil who serves as Wyll’s patron — sealed inside a mind‑flayer pod in Moonrise Towers. A nearby console presents obvious options to “unleash” her or “annihilate” her (free her or flush her down the tube), and the group must choose her fate. Mizora presses for release and will haggle about amending or ending Wyll’s pact; Wyll may or may not be present to bargain with her. If freed she escapes and flies off to wait for Wyll; if destroyed she dies — the scene follows her capture by cultists and can lead to later encounters involving Wyll.
